Class ValveTrimSizingResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign.valve.ValveTrimSizingResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class ValveTrimSizingResult extends Object implements Serializable
Result of comparing a required valve Cv with explicitly supplied trim capacity options.

      public static ValveTrimSizingResult notEvaluated(double requiredCv, String recommendation)
      Creates a result for a case that could not be evaluated.

      requiredCv - calculated required Cv, possibly not finite

      not-evaluated result

    • notEvaluated

      public static ValveTrimSizingResult notEvaluated(double requiredCv, String recommendation, double maximumAllowedUtilization)
      Creates a result for a case that could not be evaluated while retaining the configured utilization criterion.
      Parameters:
      requiredCv - calculated required Cv, possibly not finite
      recommendation - reason why the assessment was not performed
      maximumAllowedUtilization - configured utilization limit
      Returns:
      not-evaluated result

      feasible result

    • getLimitingTrimOption

      public ValveTrimOption getLimitingTrimOption()
      Gets the option used to calculate the reported utilization and margin.

      This is the selected option for a feasible result and the largest available option for an infeasible result.

      Returns:
      limiting trim option, or null when not evaluated

    • getMaximumAvailableCv

      public double getMaximumAvailableCv()
      Gets the largest maximum design Cv in the supplied catalog.
      Returns:
      maximum available Cv, or zero when not evaluated

    • getUtilization

      public double getUtilization()
      Gets Cv utilization relative to the limiting trim option.
      Returns:
      required Cv divided by the limiting trim maximum Cv

      public double getCapacityMarginCv()
      Gets the remaining Cv capacity of the limiting option.

      limiting maximum Cv minus required Cv; negative means overload
